acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Flame Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Wisp, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Cinder-Drift Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A compact limbless teardrop of magic hovers above the ground with a soft taper and no humanoid anatomy.
battlefieldDuty: Probe movement with one small drifting ignition point.
constructionDimensions: Earth forms the body from brown and umber compacted dust, clay, and small stone grains rather than red or orange fire.
A granular fringe and a few close-orbiting mineral flecks preserve the light, drifting wisp silhouette.
counterplay: Leave the dust-mote endpoint and pass through the fading granular trail before the compacted Earth magic reforms.
forbiddenTreatments: Red or orange combustion, literal flame, sparks, cinders, or burning embers
A humanoid body or a heavy rock creature that loses the small hovering wisp silhouette
identityInvariants: A small hovering magical entity keeps a flame-like or teardrop silhouette without becoming literal combustion.
Its visible body is made from its current affinity substance, so material and color change with affinity.
